name: Additive character modulo q
ant_standard_definition: e_q(an)=exp(2*pi*i*a*n/q); it is additive in n and is not generally multiplicative.
ant_to_pvg_map: Decode a valuation vector to n and evaluate its residue phase modulo q.
pvg_geometric_object: A phase label attached to a decoded PVG point and its residue channel.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode the point and recover the same finite additive character value.
kernel_or_information_loss: A fixed residue phase forgets integer scale and factorization beyond the residue class.

name: Additive-character orthogonality
ant_standard_definition: sum_{a mod q} e_q(a(n-m)) equals q when n is congruent to m modulo q and 0 otherwise.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply the character sum after decoding the two PVG points to integers.
pvg_geometric_object: A finite Fourier projector onto equality of residue channels.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: The projector returns the standard residue-congruence indicator.
kernel_or_information_loss: It distinguishes congruence modulo q only, not equality of integers or incomplete-sum cancellation.
claim_ceiling: Does not provide analytic cancellation for incomplete sums.

name: Finite Fourier transform on residue channels
ant_standard_definition: hat f(a)=sum_{r mod q} f(r)e_q(-ar), with finite inversion recovering f.
ant_to_pvg_map: Push PVG weights to residue channels and apply the finite Fourier transform.
pvg_geometric_object: The vector of residue-channel Fourier coefficients.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Finite Fourier inversion recovers the residue-channel function exactly.
kernel_or_information_loss: No loss inside the residue-channel space; the pushforward to residues may already have lost integer-scale information.

name: Parseval identity
ant_standard_definition: sum_a |hat f(a)|^2 = q sum_r |f(r)|^2 under the unnormalized convention.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply Parseval to the residue-channel function obtained from PVG weights.
pvg_geometric_object: Fourier energy of the residue-channel pushforward.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Returns the standard finite-group energy identity.
kernel_or_information_loss: Energy preserves a norm but loses phase and individual coefficient information.
claim_ceiling: Energy identity is not pointwise cancellation.

name: Exponential sum
ant_to_pvg_map: Reindex the weighted sum over decoded valuation points with the same additive phase.
pvg_geometric_object: A phase-weighted scalar observable on decoded PVG points.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode all points and recover the original finite exponential sum exactly.
kernel_or_information_loss: The scalar sum loses the individual coefficients and supplies no nontrivial estimate by itself.
claim_ceiling: No nontrivial bound without an independent cancellation argument.

name: Cancellation certificate
ant_standard_definition: A nontrivial bound below the trivial l1 bound must name the structure, parameter range, constants, hypotheses, and uniformity.
ant_to_pvg_map: Attach the same analytic certificate requirements to a PVG-reindexed exponential sum.
pvg_geometric_object: Certificate metadata on a phase-weighted PVG observable.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Returns an ANT estimate only when the named analytic hypotheses and proof are supplied.
kernel_or_information_loss: PVG reindexing does not create cancellation, Diophantine approximation, or uniformity.
claim_ceiling: Observed smallness in a finite sample is not a uniform theorem.

name: Additive versus multiplicative characters
ant_standard_definition: Additive characters diagonalize residue addition; Dirichlet characters diagonalize multiplication on reduced residue classes.
ant_to_pvg_map: Tag decoded PVG observables by the relevant additive or multiplicative channel action.
pvg_geometric_object: Two distinct phase systems on residue data: additive and multiplicative.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Returns the correct character family only when the governing group operation is retained.
kernel_or_information_loss: Conflating the group laws destroys the distinction and invalidates transfer arguments.
claim_ceiling: Do not substitute one character family for the other.

name: Addition-fiber Fourier interface
ant_standard_definition: The constraint x+y=N modulo q is isolated by q^{-1} sum_a e_q(a(x+y-N)).
ant_to_pvg_map: Decode the two PVG points and apply the finite Fourier projector to their sum constraint.
pvg_geometric_object: A Fourier projector on an addition-fiber residue channel.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Returns the standard congruence indicator for x+y=N modulo q.
kernel_or_information_loss: It detects the modular sum constraint but not primality, positivity, or a global integer equality beyond the chosen modulus.
claim_ceiling: Projector identity does not estimate prime-weighted fibers.

name: Residue Fourier loss boundary
ant_standard_definition: A fixed-modulus Fourier transform preserves residue-channel data while the residue pushforward forgets scale and cross-modulus behavior.
ant_to_pvg_map: Record the loss after pushing decoded PVG points to one modulus and Fourier transforming the channels.
pvg_geometric_object: A quotient of PVG data by equality of residue-channel aggregates.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Recovers only the residue-channel function, not the original integer-weight distribution.
kernel_or_information_loss: The kernel contains weight configurations with identical residue aggregates; scale, detailed factorization, and cross-modulus information are lost.
claim_ceiling: No global reconstruction from one modulus.

name: Orthogonality does not imply cancellation
ant_standard_definition: Exact additive orthogonality alone does not prove a nontrivial incomplete exponential-sum bound.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply the same rejection to any PVG-reindexed sum.
pvg_geometric_object: A negative reasoning constraint on Fourier projectors.
kernel_or_information_loss: The missing information is an independent oscillatory estimate and its hypotheses.

name: Fourier projector does not prove Goldbach
ant_standard_definition: The exact projector for x+y=N does not prove positivity of the prime-weighted representation count.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply the rejection to the Addition Fibers representation.
pvg_geometric_object: A negative reasoning constraint on addition-fiber encodings.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Returns the standard distinction between coefficient identity and positive representation theorem.
kernel_or_information_loss: Missing are prime weights, major-arc asymptotics, minor-arc domination, and positivity control.

name: Finite Fourier formalization status
ant_standard_definition: Finite orthogonality and inversion are formalization candidates; no project-owned Lean proof is present in this unit.
ant_to_pvg_map: Mark the corresponding finite PVG Fourier statements as future formalization candidates.
pvg_geometric_object: A formalization-status node, not a mathematical object.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Returns the same unverified formalization status.
kernel_or_information_loss: No formal proof certificate has been added.
